load data
```{r}
etp<-read_csv("/g/steinmetz/moonen/Rstudio/cre_perturbation_screen_results_traits.csv")


folder_path <- "/g/stegle/schrod/code/TCell/pseudobulk_deseq2_chunks50_min3bulks_ribosomal"
discovery_P <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_df(read_csv)

discovery_P <- discovery_P %>% mutate(grna_target = contrast, gene_symbol = variable, log_2_fold_change = log_fc, pvals_adj = adj_p_value) %>% filter(pvals_adj <=0.1 , abs(log_2_fold_change) >= 0.1)

pos_neg_genes <- discovery_P%>%
  filter(gene_symbol == grna_target, 
    !is.na(log_2_fold_change),
    log_2_fold_change < 0) %>%
  pull(gene_symbol) %>%
  unique()

```


```{r}

max_steps <- 0                 # plotted chaining depth (0 = off)
max_steps_for_size <- 1        # sizing chaining depth (set to 1 as requested)

edge_alpha <- 0.45             # <-- set edge transparency here (0..1)

class_levels <- c("promoter-proximal", "promoter-distal", "intragenic-proximal",
                  "intragenic-distal","intergenic-distal")

color_map <- c(
  CRE          ="#e57373",
  gene         = "#334068",
  pos_neg_gene = "#334068"
)

# Highlighted CRE fill (enhancer_like TRUE and distToTSS_bin != "> 1Mb")
cre_hi_fill <- "#c03a30"

# Edge colors by sign of LFC
edge_col_up   <- "#f68b41"
edge_col_down <- "#008080"

# Genes whose labels are red + bold
highlight_genes <- c("TNF","DLG1","ACTG1","PDCD6IP","SRF","EXT1","CSK")

# --- build chaining edges up to N hops (same logic as your original) ---
build_chain_edges <- function(max_steps, frontier_start, map_dp) {
  edges_chain <- tibble(from=character(), to=character(), log2fc=numeric(),
                        edge_type=character(), edge_class=character())
  if (max_steps <= 0) return(edges_chain)

  frontier <- frontier_start %>% distinct(from = to)
  seen <- frontier$from

  for (d in seq_len(max_steps)) {
    step <- frontier %>%
      inner_join(map_dp, by = c("from" = "grna_target")) %>%
      transmute(
        from,
        to         = gene_symbol,
        log2fc     = log_2_fold_change,
        edge_type  = "dp_chain",
        edge_class = NA_character_
      ) %>%
      distinct()

    if (nrow(step) == 0) break
    edges_chain <- bind_rows(edges_chain, step)

    new_nodes <- setdiff(step$to, seen)
    if (length(new_nodes) == 0) break

    frontier <- tibble(from = new_nodes)
    seen <- union(seen, new_nodes)
  }
  edges_chain
}

# --- 1) Filter ETP and create CRE -> primary gene edges ---
es_pairs <- etp %>%
  filter(str_detect(trait, "Celiac_disease")) %>%
  filter(
    pert_chr == gene_chr,
    !ctrl_perturbation,
    significant
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    cre              = grna_target,
    primary_gene     = response_id,
    interaction_type = factor(interaction_type, levels = class_levels),
    effect_size      = log_2_fold_change
  ) %>%
  distinct()

edges1 <- es_pairs %>%
  transmute(
    from       = cre,
    to         = primary_gene,
    log2fc     = effect_size,
    edge_type  = "CRE_to_gene",
    edge_class = as.character(interaction_type)
  )

# --- 2) Primary gene -> downstream gene edges from discovery_P ---
map_dp <- discovery_P %>%
  select(grna_target, gene_symbol, log_2_fold_change) %>%
  distinct()

edges2 <- es_pairs %>%
  inner_join(map_dp, by = c("primary_gene" = "grna_target")) %>%
  transmute(
    from       = primary_gene,
    to         = gene_symbol,
    log2fc     = log_2_fold_change,
    edge_type  = "gene_to_gene",
    edge_class = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# --- 3) Optional chaining for PLOTTED graph ---
edges_chain_plot <- build_chain_edges(
  max_steps = max_steps,
  frontier_start = edges2,
  map_dp = map_dp
)

# --- 3b) Chaining for SIZING graph (always 1 hop as requested) ---
edges_chain_size <- build_chain_edges(
  max_steps = max_steps_for_size,
  frontier_start = edges2,
  map_dp = map_dp
)

# --- 4) Combine edges for plotted graph and build graph ---
edge_list <- bind_rows(edges1, edges2, edges_chain_plot) %>%
  filter(from != to) %>%
  distinct(from, to, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes <- tibble(name = unique(c(edge_list$from, edge_list$to))) %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      name %in% es_pairs$cre     ~ "CRE",
      name %in% pos_neg_genes    ~ "pos_neg_gene",
      TRUE                       ~ "gene"
    )
  )

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edge_list, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)

# --- 5) Define highlighted CREs from etp (enhancer_like TRUE & not >1Mb) ---
highlight_cres <- etp %>%
  filter(str_detect(trait, "Celiac_disease")) %>%
  filter(
    !ctrl_perturbation,
    significant,
    enhancer_like_interaction == TRUE,
    distToTSS_bin != "> 1Mb"
  ) %>%
  distinct(grna_target) %>%
  pull(grna_target)

V(g)$is_hi_cre <- (V(g)$name %in% highlight_cres) & (V(g)$type == "CRE")

# --- 6) Compute node sizes from out-degree under max_steps_for_size = 1 ---
edge_list_size <- bind_rows(edges1, edges2, edges_chain_size) %>%
  filter(from != to) %>%
  distinct(from, to, .keep_all = TRUE)

g_size <- graph_from_data_frame(
  edge_list_size,
  directed = TRUE,
  vertices = tibble(name = unique(c(edge_list_size$from, edge_list_size$to)))
)

out_deg_size <- degree(g_size, mode = "out")
V(g)$out_deg_for_size <- unname(out_deg_size[V(g)$name])
V(g)$out_deg_for_size[is.na(V(g)$out_deg_for_size)] <- 0

# --- 7) Plot (minimalist Nature vibe, original FR layout, no fading) ---
tg <- as_tbl_graph(g) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_width = rescale(abs(log2fc), to = c(1, 4)),
    edge_dir   = if_else(log2fc >= 0, "up", "down"),
    edge_col   = if_else(edge_dir == "up", edge_col_up, edge_col_down)
  ) %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(
    node_size  = rescale(out_deg_for_size, to = c(5, 14)),
    base_fill  = color_map[type],
    node_fill  = if_else(is_hi_cre, cre_hi_fill, base_fill),

    # make CREs and highlighted CREs slightly larger + use diamond (shape 23)
    node_shape = if_else(type == "CRE", 23L, 21L),
    node_size2 = if_else(type == "CRE", node_size * 1.25, node_size),

    label_col  = if_else(name %in% highlight_genes, "#b30000", "grey65"),
    label_face = if_else(name %in% highlight_genes, "bold", "plain"),

    glow_alpha = if_else(is_hi_cre, 0.18, 0.00),
    glow_size  = if_else(is_hi_cre, node_size2 * 2.2, node_size2)
  )

set.seed(1)
ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = edge_width, colour = edge_col),
    alpha = edge_alpha,          # <-- fixed alpha you control
    lineend = "round",
    end_cap = circle(1.6, "mm"),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.7, "mm"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  # Subtle glow halo (only for highlighted CREs)
  #geom_node_point(
 #   aes(size = glow_size, alpha = glow_alpha),
 #   colour = cre_hi_fill,
 #   shape = 16
 # ) +
  # Main nodes (no outline); CREs are shape 23 and slightly larger
  geom_node_point(
    aes(size = node_size2, fill = node_fill, shape = factor(node_shape)),
    stroke = 0
  ) +
  # Labels: highlighted genes are bold + red
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name, colour = label_col, fontface = label_face),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 9.0,
    box.padding = unit(0.35, "lines"),
    point.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 1
  ) +
  scale_edge_width_identity() +
  scale_size_identity() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`21` = 21, `23` = 23)) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_equal(clip = "off")


```
